data.description: Weather now and for the next 7 days anywhere, e.g. "will it rain in Cluj tomorrow?". Data: Open-Meteo.

data.prompt: The input asks about the weather somewhere. Reply with the place as it is named on a map, just the city or town (e.g. Cluj-Napoca, not "Cluj, Romania"). Complete a short name of the same place (Cluj is Cluj-Napoca), but never swap in a different place: a name you don't recognise is copied as written. Also reply with the country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code if the input names or clearly implies the country (e.g. RO), otherwise an empty string.
